name: Lumae Analysis
author: Lumae
description: Mirrors supported Navidrome catalogues and prepares Lumae volume, SmoothFade, album-similarity, and artist-similarity data away from the phone.

versions.changelog: Move album and artist relationship preparation to AudioMuse using Lumae's native scoring model, publish relationship and playback-profile cursor streams, and keep all enrichment asynchronous so catalogue setup finishes immediately.

Map every Navidrome track to provider music folders even when no folder filter is configured, replace large N+1 album hydration scans with bounded folder and song pagination, reject partial or unknown memberships, and automatically rebuild affected catalogue generations.

Preserve selected Navidrome folder memberships through catalogue hydration, automatically prepare and repair catalogues through an idempotent mobile API, keep published generations available during refresh, and rebuild safely after catalogue-builder upgrades.

Prevent selected Navidrome music folders from producing an empty catalogue, reject every zero-track publication, and make required app-sync readiness unmistakable before separate sonic verification and optional waveform work.

Keep repair-flagged AudioMuse 3 mappings usable as provisional sonic links, preserve their conflict evidence for automatic replacement, reproject automatically after update, avoid unchanged journal churn, and make Firefox-safe GET status polling.
Sync AudioMuse 3 sonic links progressively while Chromaprint backfills, keep incomplete groups usable unless they definitely disagree, and add a read-only source-scoped database state dashboard.
Complete v2-to-v3 source rebinding before readiness checks, accept only proven legacy aliases, and prevent stale legacy tasks from reaching the AudioMuse 3 registry.
Qualify AudioMuse 3.0.4 and 3.0.5 with exact patch-bound readiness acknowledgements while keeping later 3.x releases fail-closed.
Make Lumae usable as soon as the Navidrome catalogue and AudioMuse projection publish; move waveform coverage to bounded background batches and prioritize current playback tracks.
Provide a Navidrome-only, source-safe catalogue with Prepare Lumae and one coalesced catalogue, projection, and profile update per AudioMuse analysis run.
Qualify AudioMuse 3.0.3 with source-scoped Chromaprint coverage, repair-sequence diagnostics, and an administrator-controlled sync readiness gate.
Add the provider-authoritative catalogue capability and a dual AudioMuse 2.6/v3 compatibility handshake.
Make personal versus shared collection scope explicit and add principal-scoped, checksummed JSON backups with full-library and per-collection export plus safe additive restore in the web manager.
Fix the collection library track query on PostgreSQL by sorting on the source author column instead of a nested SELECT alias, restoring initial browsing and search.

Replace the basic add dialog with an art-first Albums, Tracks, and Artists library workbench; add categorized search, artist and album drill-down, provider track/disc numbers, bulk collection management, cover art, and credential-safe audio previews.
Expose enabled Living Collections in the Plugins menu, restore opaque high-contrast dialogs, and fix Add music requests so selected albums and tracks are persisted with visible progress and errors.
Add opt-in Living Collections with mixed album and track membership, a responsive AudioMuse manager, per-user storage, revisions, idempotent mutations, and incremental sync.
Vectorize the BS.1770 biquad filter with SciPy so loudness and MixRamp profiles are ready before playback catches the analysis queue.
Add Queue Whole Library to enqueue every missing, stale, or changed Lumae profile in 250-track worker jobs while keeping Catch Up Now for one batch.
